latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Build a detailed 13-week rolling cash flow forecast from real inputs, flagging risk weeks and suggesting actions.

- Accepts actual balances, income, and expenses (fixed and variable) to generate weekly forecasts.
- Flags when balance dips below user-defined safety buffer.
- Calculates runway and highlights risk periods with actionable recommendations.
- Compares best-case vs worst-case income timing scenarios.
- Clear, direct output format for founders and businesses managing cash flow.
